title: You thought the storm was outside the church.
paragraphs:
You thought the storm was outside the church.
God says it started inside.

You can sit in a pew…
and still be at war with God.

You can raise your hands…
and still be hiding something that owns you.

You can say “Amen”…
while your heart whispers, “Don’t touch that part, Lord.”
And here’s the tension nobody likes to preach:
God doesn’t ignore what we hide.
🔥 THE THING YOU WON’T SAY OUT LOUD
It’s not always the big scandal.

A secret addiction no one suspects.
Bitterness you’ve justified for years.
Pride dressed up as “discernment.”
A double life that looks holy on Sunday…
but hollow on Monday.
“As long as no one sees it… I’m okay.”
⚖️ SCRIPTURE THAT CUTS THROUGH THE NOISE
“For it is time for judgment to begin at the house of God…” — 1 Peter 4:17

Some scholars interpret this “judgment” as persecution from outside forces refining believers. Others understand it as God’s internal purification—His loving discipline that confronts sin within His own people.
Either way, the message is clear:
💥 WHY THIS HURTS (AND WHY IT’S MERCY)

Because we’ve mastered looking clean…
without being clean.
“Woe to you… you clean the outside… but inside you are full of greed and self-indulgence.” — Matthew 23:25
Because external religion can hide internal rebellion.

And God loves you too much
to let you fake your way through faith.

Because if you stop at “judgment,”
you’ll miss the heart of God.

Judgment in His house
is not about rejection.
“Those whom I love, I rebuke and discipline…” — Revelation 3:19

Not whom I abandon.
Not whom I cancel.
Not whom I shame publicly.

So if God is pressing on something in your life right now—
that thing you keep dodging—
That’s not proof He’s done with you.
That’s proof He’s still fighting for you.
✝️ THE GOSPEL — WHERE JUDGMENT WAS SATISFIED
Here’s the truth that sets captives free:
You don’t have to carry the punishment of your sin.
“He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree…” — 1 Peter 2:24

At the cross,
God’s justice and mercy collided.

If you are in Christ,
judgment is no longer condemnation.
“There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.” — Romans 8:1

Invitation to step out of hiding.
Invitation to repent without fear.
Invitation to be made whole.
What is God touching right now?

That attitude?
That habit?
That relationship?
That hidden compromise?

Because delayed obedience
is still disobedience.

Right now—yes, right now—
you can come clean before God.
“If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us… and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.” — 1 John 1:9
That thing you think disqualifies you?

That might be the very place
God wants to redeem you.
If you’re ready to stop hiding and start healing,
